set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-ci. Resume before new runtime feature work (AGENTS T3).

Observed failure: source main 8d4881a931fb809b27ac7ad14478fe60cde1e6e3, GitHub run https://github.com/bbuchsbaum/storymodel4s/actions/runs/37620122197, attempt 1, Native job 112788512394 (ubuntu-22.04 / Scala 3.7.4 / temurin17 / rootNative).
WorkspaceVoyageSuite test "external global winner with residual source mass does not become a source anchor" timed out after 30 seconds (reported 30.907s). Producer beforeAll setup took 63593ms; suite took 166.771s. fixturesNative totals: 159 Passed, 1 Failed, 0 Errors, 0 ignored of 160. All 14 executed Native test cells totaled 2786 Passed, 1 Failed, 0 Errors; the run stopped before lawsNative, so this is not a complete Native gate. JVM17/JVM21/JS jobs passed. The earlier qualified exact-code run 37613462330 passed all platforms. This failure is a timing/fixture reliability finding, not evidence of a numerical golden mismatch.

The failed job was rerun through gh on 7 October; retain attempt 1 regardless of the rerun outcome. A retry pass alone does not close a reliability ticket.

Remaining work / acceptance:
1. Diagnose/profile the exact Native fixture path from an isolated clone. Separate shared producer construction and checked repacking/setup from the named adapter property under test; identify which work actually consumes its timeout.
2. Implement the smallest justified fixture/performance or explicitly measured platform-budget correction. Keep all external-winner, residual source mass, no-source-anchor, and accepting-control assertions; do not skip the test, lower the witness workload without preserving discrimination, or alter algorithmic/numerical semantics merely to turn CI green.
3. Reproduce the failure or document runner-dependent timing with retained commands, platform, source SHA, duration and counts. Show the repaired named test and control pass, then the reference-scoped fixture dependents on all supported platforms and a fresh exact-head hosted Native run. If a budget changes, bind its justification to measured Native work rather than an arbitrary global timeout.
4. Independent exact-SHA review and current-main CI are required before declaring recovery. Close only after the repair/disposition lands; record retry success separately from stable qualification.

Scope: fixture/test reliability first. Runtime feature work remains behind this P0. Use synthetic checked workspace fixtures; no private data, hosted model calls or new benchmark reads. Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md.
set.title: Make WorkspaceVoyage fixture tests reliable on hosted Native
